items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: This is where he reminds me of Jerry Veal sometimes. Jerry Veal seems a very pretty number.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. Those are... Maybe... That's Capitol. That's something else. Don't bother if you look it up. I would have them because I get everything that comes out by them. That's Southland. You see it? I have a lot of money got records here.
This is where he reminds me of Jerry Veal sometimes. Jerry Veal seems a very pretty number. Oh, yeah. I'm one of these things. I started to ask how he would dress in Chicago.
You mentioned that the diamond in his tooth and all. Well, listen here. That's why I have a final picture of him. He's got a light gray suit on, and it looks so much like him.
